scope: Offline permutation stress test and fresh in-memory diagnostic critic fits on the saved 300-state trace only.

formal_cache_candidate_reconstruction.method: Official saved-scenario/vehicle-prediction artifacts plus rollout._cache_candidates; task labels and realized vehicle trajectories stubbed empty; no environment execution.
formal_cache_candidate_reconstruction.legal_mask_rule: all candidates returned by the official legal candidate generator; Cache candidate index 0 is KEEP, all nonzero candidates are UPDATE; duration masks permit configured durations 1/3/5.

current_checkpoint29_permutation_sensiti.probability_definition: Checkpoint29 official macro candidate encoder/scorers, formal legal masks, KEEP/UPDATE group balance, masked categorical; duration is marginalized over the exact formal Cache categorical using the conditional duration head for each legal Cache candidate.

sensitivity_classification_rule.MATERIAL: ratio >= 0.05, or raw median VALUE_PERM_STD > 10x measured DeepSets floating-error floor

A.name: CURRENT_RAW_FLATTEN
A.model: fresh v9-style macro critic 400->128->128->1 with SiLU hidden activations; input transform 2*x-1

B.name: CANONICAL_TRAJECTORY_ORDER
B.sort_key: 10 normalized coordinates lexicographically x0,y0,x1,y1,...,x4,y4; rounded to 1e-8 for primary key with exact trajectory values as deterministic tie-break; vehicle ID is never used
B.restored_layout: sorted vehicle identities are written back into all five horizons, then flattened horizon-major to preserve the 400D contract

C.name: DEEPSETS_TRAJECTORY_ENCODER
C.vehicle_input: 25 shared 10D per-vehicle trajectories [x0,y0,...,x4,y4]; invalid horizon values remain zero-filled; global 5D horizon mask is retained
C.pooling: 64D concat(mean_pool,max_pool); mean accumulation uses float64 then casts to float32 to keep permutation roundoff negligible

offline_critic_fit.purpose: Fresh temporary in-memory diagnostic critics only; no use of checkpoint29 critic for A/B/C fit comparison.

model_reinitialization.A_B: Exact same freshly initialized macro_critic weights copied from a DualTimescaleActorCritic v9 instance initialized with seed 27005; B uses canonical input only.
model_reinitialization.C: Same common 150 nonvehicle first-layer columns and downstream head weights/biases as A; new pooled-context columns use derived seed 27008 fan-in-scale initialization; phi layers use derived seeds 27006/27007.

matched_fit.rule: For each candidate/target/fold, first post-update step <=200 where TRAIN_EV >=0.90; report test metrics at that step. Summary is median among folds reaching the threshold.

origin_calibration.predictions: Out-of-fold predictions from the four unseen test episodes 20002-20005, using the fold's step-200 critic.

gate.candidate_rule: At least 3/4 unseen test folds have step-200 realized-return TEST_EV greater than A; plus median step-200 TEST_EV delta >=0.15, or median matched-fit TEST_EV delta >=0.15, or median absolute origin prediction bias reduction >=20%; no systematic return-correlation deterioration (median delta >=-0.10 and fewer than 3 folds down by >0.15).
gate.selection_rule: Prefer B whenever B passes; select C only when B fails and C passes; otherwise NONE.

TEMP_FILES_CLEANED: YES: temporary scripts and candidate feature NPZ removed; __pycache__ and *.pyc removed; no diagnostic model checkpoint/tensor saved.
NEXT_DECISION: 优先采用 B，若 CANONICAL_TRAJECTORY_GATE=PASS；否则仅在 C 通过时再考虑 DeepSets。若 B/C 均失败或当前 checkpoint 的排列敏感度为 LOW，则维持正式 architecture，转查 Macro value calibration / structural resource context。
